content_of_post_to_comment: People don't actually want freedom. They want the feeling of freedom inside a structure that makes all their decisions for them. That's why they love routines, algorithms, and strong opinions from strangers on the internet. The cage most people live in was built by themselves, furnished nicely, and called a ‘comfort zone’.
comment: Maybe the deeper issue isn't that people reject freedom, but that freedom requires carrying the burden of choosing. Structure can be a form of relief, not just a cage.
